Class UpsertPaymentRefundFlowControllerTest

@IsTest
private class UpsertPaymentRefundFlowControllerTest

Test class for UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController. Tests the creation and update of payment refunds in Firestore, including validation of the integration with Firestore API endpoints.

Methods

private static String getPaymentBody(Payment2__c pay)

Helper method that generates a mock Firestore payment response body for testing. Creates a JSON string representing a payment document with existing refunds and order data.

Parameters:
    pay – Payment record used to populate the mock response data

Returns:
    String JSON-formatted Firestore payment document response

@TestSetup
private static void setTestData()

Creates test data for all test methods including BlazeBite settings, Account, and Payment records.

@IsTest
private static void upsertExistingRefundInFirestoreTest()

Tests the update of an existing refund in Firestore when a refund ID is provided. Verifies that the refund is successfully updated and marked as an update (not created).

@IsTest
private static void upsertNewRefundInFirestoreTest()

Tests the creation of a new refund in Firestore when no refund ID is provided. Verifies that the refund is successfully created with an auto-generated ID and marked as created.
